long_description:
Immersive Yoga: Oceanic Flow
Flow with the ocean through immersive visuals, soothing sounds and mindful Hatha yoga in a multi-sensory journey of movement and calm.

About this Event


Immersive Yoga: Oceanic Flow




It’s not just yoga; it’s an experience!

Immersive yoga combines yoga with cutting-edge technology to fully engage the senses, creating a transformative oceanic flow. We’re collaborating with a visual artist, using high-tech projectors, to bring the studio to life with stunning ocean scenes, enhancing the practice and deepening the connection to the present moment.

You'll be surrounded by stunning ocean visuals, the calming scents of sea air, and the soothing sounds of waves, creating a multi-sensory experience.

This yoga class synchronises your movements with the natural flow of the ocean, blending graceful Hatha poses and deep breathing into a meditative experience. Perfect for relaxation and reconnecting with nature.





Please try to arrive by 5:45pm so we can get everyone into the event and start on time at 6pm.





Enjoy an amazing plant-based dinner and dessert, all included in your ticket!



Meet your host Nicola

Nicola of Namaste Nicola is a dedicated yoga teacher with over 20 years of experience teaching across Australia and New Zealand. With more than 300 hours of training with international teachers, her approach is gentle, soulful, and deeply grounded in yoga philosophy. Nicola creates a calm and nurturing space where students can slow down, rest deeply, and reconnect with themselves through practices such as Yoga Nidra, Hatha, and Yin Yoga.




Agenda


🕑: 05:45 PM - 06:00 PM
Arrive to Bhakti Lounge

🕑: 06:00 PM - 07:00 PM
Immersive Yoga: Oceanic Flow
Host: Nicola

🕑: 07:00 PM - 08:15 PM
Plant-based dinner and dessert!

SHORT SHARP SCRIPT 2 | WRITERS ON MONDAYS
Another fast, funny, and furious set of scripts from the IIML’s scriptwriting students. This week the spotlight falls on work by Lynnette Harris, Nova Moala-Knox, Annika Peterson, Sarah Powell, and Sam Pretious, introduced by Ken Duncum.

Writers on Mondays is presented by the International Institute of Modern Letters and The Museum of New Zealand Te Papa Tongarewa. The 2026 series will run from 12.15—1.15 pm each Monday from 6 July to 28 September at Te Papa and Circa Theatre, with two special evening sessions at Meow. Admission is free and all are welcome. The series is supported by the Letteri family.

The full programme can be viewed here: https://www.wgtn.ac.nz/modernletters/about/events/writers-mondays

Come celebrate Aotearoa writers with us at Writers on Mondays – we look forward to seeing you there.

long_description:
Miramar Night Market
✨ Miramar Night Market is back! ✨

Kick off the festive season with one of Wellington's favourite community events!

Join us on Saturday, 21 November 2026, from 3.00pm – 8.00pm for an unforgettable summer evening filled with delicious food, local creativity and a vibrant community atmosphere.

Browse an incredible range of handcrafted treasures from talented artists and makers across the Wellington region, including:

⭐ Plants, flowers and seedlings
⭐ Jewellery
⭐ Clothing, bags and accessories
⭐ Handmade toys and crochet creations
⭐ Candles and home fragrances
⭐ Homewares and soft furnishings
⭐ Baby and children's gifts
⭐ Natural skincare, soaps and cosmetics
⭐ Resin art and crystals
⭐ Ceramics and pottery
⭐ Woodwork and metal art
⭐ Carvings and sculptures
⭐ Pet accessories
⭐ Wool products
⭐ And so much more!

Come hungry! Our line up of popular food trucks, coffee carts and sweet treats has something for everyone. Grab dinner, relax on the back lawn, enjoy live entertainment, and let the kids burn off some energy on the playground.

Whether you're searching for unique Christmas gifts, supporting local makers, or simply looking for a fun night out with family and friends, the Miramar Night Market is the perfect way to welcome summer and get into the festive spirit.

Most stalls will offer EFTPOS, but bringing some cash is always a good idea.

Great food. Amazing local talent. A warm summer evening. We can't wait to see you there!

Simply Weekend 2026
Simply Weekend returns for 2026! We have a huge weekend in store for you, including more workshops and social dancing than ever and a brand new mega-party on Sunday evening at Foxglove on the beautiful Wellington waterfront.

We've made a few changes to Simply this year. We have a total of 12 workshops available throughout the weekend - 6 open workshops and 6 advanced level workshops. We've also packed even more social dancing into the schedule so you're less likely to finish the weekend thinking "dang, I didn't get a chance to dance with that amazing dancer".

Simply no longer includes a competition, and the Te Papa Ball has been replaced with a bash at Foxglove instead (which is gonna be frickin' fantastic). These changes mean that we've been able to make our weekend packages more affordable.

Registrations open now. https://idance.co.nz/simply

Inspired by Bumble, our giant bee sculpture designed by artist Bonnie Brown for Bee in the City, our Bumble & Blossom High tea brings honey and blossom flavours to an elegant selection of sweet and savoury delights, all served with bottomless TWG Tea.

We're immensely proud to be sponsoring Bumble as part of Bee in the City, Wellington's public art trail. At the end of the trail, each giant bee will be auctioned off with the proceeds going to the Life Flight Trust.

About this Event



WELLINGTON - The Arborist Rooftop Bar

Monthly Topic: Focus, Flow and Productivity

Hosted by:

Running a business can often feel like juggling a hundred priorities at once. This month's networking session is all about creating more focus, finding your flow, and working in a way that feels productive without leading to burnout. Together we will share practical strategies, tools and ideas to help you minimise distractions, stay accountable, prioritise what matters most, and build a business that works with you, not against you. Leave with fresh inspiration and simple actions you can put into practice straight away.

Want to get your ticket for FREE?

Are you a woman in business looking for a supportive community to help you connect, grow, and learn?

As an Inner Circle member, you can attend as many of our networking hubs as you like for FREE! This includes our hubs across Auckland, NZ, Australia and the UK. Enjoy unlimited access to our networking events and take full advantage of the community and networking opportunities.

Ready to join the Inner Circle?

Not quite ready to commit? Try the Inner Circle FREE for 7 days and experience the community for yourself.

Monthly Masterclasses:

Personal Branding Opportunities:

Vibrant Community:

Share your journey, get support, and celebrate your successes with empowering women.

now and become part of a wonderful community of women in business who are ready to build their dream life and business.

Whether you're just starting out with new business ideas or have years of experience under your belt, all are welcome! Empower Her provides a safe space where you can share your business with others, connect with like-minded women in business, and prioritise collaboration over competition.

Our groups value the power of connection, and we believe that together, we can achieve more than we ever could alone. That's why we're committed to fostering a supportive community that empowers each member to reach their full potential. Our groups are focused on connection, inspiring stories, celebrating each other's successes and sharing our vulnerable moments.

Join our free community

Empower Her Co-Founders Victoria and Charlotte are highly passionate and dedicated to empowering female leaders in the business world. By joining Empower Her, you will not only expand your professional network but also gain access to a supportive community of like-minded individuals who are committed to helping each other succeed.

Maori Women’s Welfare League Opening Weekend
Join us in celebrating the 75th anniversary of the Maori Women’s Welfare League and the opening of the display Tatau Tatau: Te Ropu Wahine Maori Toko i te Ora | Maori Women’s Welfare League. Discover the extraordinary history and work of the League through a weekend of kōrero, waiata, and raranga.

Since 1951, the Maori Women’s Welfare League has supported the wellbeing of wāhine Māoriand their whānau. Working with wāhine – tatau tatau – to improve housing, education, health, and employment for Māori.

With over 130 peka and 3,000 members across Aotearoa and in Australia, you’ll find hard-working volunteers in every community.

Celebrate Te Ropu Wahine Maori Toko i te Ora and learn about this important mahi from League representatives from different rohe, as well as join in waiata and live raranga demonstrations.

Mandarin Corner: Chinese gold-foil burning art
Join our Mandarin Corner, a relaxed meet‑up to practise Mandarin with native speakers. Explore gold in Chinese art and create your own simple gold‑foil design.

Discover the cultural symbolism of gold in Chinese art and explore the beauty of traditional gold-foil design.

Learn about its history and decorative techniques through a short introduction and demonstration.

All materials are provided free of charge.

name: Wellington Waterfront Public Sculpture Walk
venue: Wellington Waterfront,Wellington, New Zealand
long_description:
Wellington Waterfront Public Sculpture Walk
A 90minute guided walk around 10 public sculptures located along Wellington's waterfront.

Sue Elliott, former Chair of the Trust and longstanding trustee, will guide a walk from Parliament grounds (the former Radio New Zealand site on Bowen Street), along the waterfront and ending at Waitangi Park.
En route we will view ten Wellington Sculpture Trust works where Sue will speak to the nature of each work, its relation to its site, the artistic intent, and the commissioning process.

Booking is REQUIRED for this event.
Cost: Free

Learn more and book on our website:
https://wellingtonheritagefestival.co.nz/event/wellington-waterfront-public-sculpture-walk/

This event is part of the 2026 Wellington Heritage Festival, running 24th October - 15th November. Discover over 160 more events on our website:
https://wellingtonheritagefestival.co.nz/events/

Health & Safety:
A second trustee will accompany the Guide to assist in directing participants in a manner to avoid risk with traffic, other pedestrians and cyclists. Please wear good walking shoes and dress for the weather. The tour may be cancelled in bad weather.
